move: two dot lattices drift diagonally at parallax speeds, breathing in waves
how: A canvas on off-white draws two dot fields: a fine 56px lattice of 3px dots at 35% and a coarser 112px lattice of 6px dots at 70%, offset from each other. Each frame both lattices shift one full pitch diagonally over D (the coarse one moves twice as far in pixels so it reads nearer), and every dot radius breathes between 0.65x and 1.35x on a diagonal sine wave that crosses the field once per D. A radial fade softens the edges into the background. D is 2s.
adapt: Change the dot colour and background, the two pitches and radii, or the drift direction; fewer layers reads calmer. Keep whole-pitch travel per D so the loop is seamless.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the canvas and fade overlay; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one linear progress tween over D whose onUpdate redraws both lattices, replacing fx.register. Draw loops use the canvas size, so it adapts to any shot. gsap.min.js is loaded but unused.
caveats: loads gsap but does not use it
